members.snippet: Soldiers disarm unexploded ordnance in Zawtar al-Gharbiyah, near where Israeli forces reportedly built an earth barrier.

events.headline: US slams Chinese ‘nature reserve’ as effort to claim South China Sea

members.title: US slams Chinese ‘nature reserve’ as effort to claim South China Sea
members.snippet: US State Department accuses China of attempting to deny Filipino vessels access to fishing grounds in contested area.
